title: KFUPM ePrints Record
description: JSON Schema for a record returned by the KFUPM ePrints JSON export endpoint (/cgi/export/eprint/{eprintid}/JSON/{filename}). Derived from a live 2026-08-30 probe of the real endpoint, not from EPrints documentation. Field names and types are exactly those observed. Note the KFUPM-local `arabic_abstract` field alongside `english_abstract` — a genuinely institution-specific extension to the stock EPrints model. Personal data observed in live records (student contact_email, advisor and creator names) is described here but no live values are stored in this repo.

Name.description: EPrints compound name. All four parts observed; lineage and honourific were null in the sampled record.

Contributor.description: A creator, advisor, co-advisor or committee member. Contains personal data.

Document.description: An attached document. KFUPM applies embargoes: the sampled record carried security 'staffonly' and date_embargo '2027-06-28'.

eprintid.description: Numeric identifier; the same number used in the OAI identifier oai:eprints.kfupm.edu.sa:{eprintid}.

examples: King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals

arabic_abstract.description: KFUPM-local field. Arabic-language abstract; not part of the stock EPrints model.

contact_email.description: PERSONAL DATA. Live records expose an individual student mailbox under kfupm.edu.sa. Do not redistribute.

subjects.description: KFUPM subject codes, e.g. 'F18', 'F7'. The same codes appear hex-encoded in OAI-PMH setSpecs.

dir.description: Internal EPrints storage path; leaked by the export endpoint.
